title: CrowdMath: A Dataset of Crowdsourced Mathematical Research Discussions
abstract: arXiv:2606.06526v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models have made substantial progress on mathematical reasoning, but existing benchmarks typically evaluate well-specified problems with final answers, step-by-step solutions, or complete proofs. They do not capture collaborative open-problem solving: a setting in which participants propose partial arguments, identify gaps or errors in prior steps, repair flawed reasoning, and gradually synthesize incremental contributions into a proof. We introduce CrowdMath, a dataset of 164 expert-annotated progress chains from the MIT PRIMES--Art of Problem Solving (AoPS) CrowdMath program (2016-2025), a collaborative research initiative whose discussions have led to peer-reviewed publications. Each chain traces a multi-participant forum discussion from an open-problem statement to a completed proof. Posts are labeled by their functional roles in the evolving solution process, including partial progress, proof completion, erroneous

translated_title: CrowdMath：一个众包数学研究讨论数据集
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型在数学推理方面已取得显著进展，但现有的基准测试通常评估的是定义明确的问题，这些问题的答案形式为最终答案、分步解答或完整证明。它们未能捕捉协作式的开放问题求解：在这种情境中，参与者提出部分论证，识别先前步骤中的漏洞或错误，修复有缺陷的推理，并逐步将增量贡献综合成一个完整的证明。我们提出了CrowdMath，这是一个包含164条由专家标注的进展链的数据集，来源于MIT PRIMES—Art of Problem Solving (AoPS) CrowdMath项目（2016-2025），这是一个协作研究计划，其讨论成果已发表为同行评审的出版物。每条进展链记录了从开放问题的陈述到完成证明的多参与者论坛讨论过程。帖子根据其在不断演进的求解过程中的功能角色进行标注，包括部分进展、证明完成、错误……
tldr: 该论文提出了CrowdMath数据集，包含来自MIT PRIMES-AoPS CrowdMath项目的164条专家标注的协作数学研究讨论链，用于评估大语言模型在协作式开放问题求解方面的能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces CrowdMath, a dataset of 164 expert-annotated progress chains from collaborative mathematical research discussions in the MIT PRIMES-AoPS CrowdMath program, designed to evaluate large language models' capabilities in collaborative open-problem solving.
